verdict.rationale: Amplitude has a documented MCP server that surfaces behavioral answers in AI tools and a Dashboard REST API to pull chart/graph data in JSON, giving an agent building blocks to construct a dashboard. However there's no evidence of an API/MCP capability to create or configure a new dashboard end-to-end (only export/read existing chart data), and no hands-on or independent confirmation that an agent can fully build a dashboard via these interfaces. missing for 10: documented API/MCP method to create/configure dashboards (not just read data), end-to-end agent-built dashboard example, independent/hands-on validation of the workflow.
